notes: The log now says why each LoRA loaded, not just which ones did. A LoRA whose WHEN field is empty applies to every photo — right for a style LoRA, a trap for a subject one, because its trigger words then ride a picture that has nothing to do with it. The route line listed the LoRA either way, so an accidental always-on subject LoRA looked identical to a genuine keyword match. Each entry now carries its reason: always, kw, 18+, 18+&kw, or picked by the photo director.
